column1: To make our economy stronger and more productive, we must make health care more affordable, and ensure that every American, regardless of income, has access to quality medical services. By reforming our system, investing in innovative solutions, and empowering communities, we can reduce burdensome costs while strengthening our workforce. This vision promotes not only prosperity but also security – a healthier nation means a stronger economy, fueling progress for every citizen across our nation steadily.
